headline: Hedging Demand Drives Swedish Rate Market Expectations Above Forecasts
summary: Financial markets are pricing in three to four Riksbank rate hikes next year, exceeding economist forecasts. Handelsbanken noted dysfunctional market conditions are inflating demand for rate protection.
why: Sweden's Riksbank adjusts benchmark borrowing costs to curb inflation. Divergence between market rate pricing and bank forecasts creates volatility in Swedish krona assets and mortgage rates.

impacts.name: Handelsbanken
impacts.why: Handelsbanken highlighted market dysfunction in Swedish interest rate protection demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Elevated demand for interest rate hedging pushed market rate hike expectations well beyond standard economic forecasts.
